## 今日输入

- **材料：** [The Standard Model](https://home.web.cern.ch/science/physics/standard-model)
- **来源：** CERN
- **预计用时：** 8–10 分钟

## 为什么值得用

标准模型是自然科学中最典型的‘分类框架 + 适用边界’文本：它把物质粒子（夸克、轻子）与传递力的玻色子清晰分层，同时坦诚指出引力尚未被纳入其中。

## 第一遍｜5 分钟：抓核心机制与证据边界

1. **Core claim**：文章试图解释什么现象？
2. **Mechanism**：关键作用力或变量是什么？
3. **Boundary**：哪些部分尚未被直接观测或仍在模型之外？

[[50-courses/English/English|English]] · [[50-courses/English/Daily/2026-10-14|今日材料]] · [[50-courses/English/Vocabulary/2026-10-14|今日词汇]]

## 练习｜TOEFL / CET-6 学术段落

### 中文原文

一套好的分类框架不仅能概括已知现象，还能标出自身解释力的边界。虽然该模型成功预测了多种基本粒子的存在及其相互作用强度，但它并未解释暗物质的本质，也未能把引力纳入同一数学体系。因此，物理学家把这套理论视为当前最可靠的阶段性描述，而非最终答案。

> [!answer]- 参考译文
> A strong classification framework not only summarizes known phenomena but also marks the boundaries of its own explanatory power. Although the model has successfully predicted the existence of multiple elementary particles and the strength of their interactions, it neither explains the nature of dark matter nor incorporates gravity into the same mathematical framework. Physicists therefore treat the theory as our most reliable working description rather than a final answer.

# English Vocabulary — 2026-10-14：核心学术表达（6 个词块）

[[50-courses/English/English|English]] · [[50-courses/English/Daily/2026-10-14|今日材料]] · [[50-courses/English/Translation/2026-10-14|今日翻译]]

## 1. fundamental building blocks

- **含义：** 基本构成单元
- **例句：** *Quarks and leptons serve as the fundamental building blocks of ordinary matter.*

## 2. mediate a force

- **含义：** 传递某种相互作用力
- **例句：** *Gauge bosons mediate the fundamental forces between matter particles.*

## 3. incorporate into

- **含义：** 纳入；整合进
- **例句：** *Gravity has not yet been incorporated into the Standard Model.*

## 4. explanatory power

- **含义：** 解释力
- **例句：** *A model's explanatory power depends on how many independent observations it unifies.*

## 5. working description

- **含义：** 阶段性/工作性描述
- **例句：** *The framework remains an indispensable working description despite known gaps.*

## 6. leave unanswered

- **含义：** 留下未解之问
- **例句：** *Several cosmological observations leave key questions unanswered.*
